### 1 of 1. 2 unused imports in src/widgets are never used

### What was found
Two lines near the top of a file bring in a name from elsewhere in the code, called imports, but nothing in that file uses the name. They are at `src/widgets/render.ts` line 2 and `src/widgets/format.ts` line 3. No other card touches these files.

### Why it matters
The housekeeping base rules, in their Code section, say to remove brought-in names, variables and modules that nothing uses. Unused lines like these make readers think the file depends on code it doesn't.

### What happens if you accept
Those two lines are deleted and nothing else changes. You get one pull request with that change against the default branch, and your main checkout stays as it is. Undoing it means reverting one commit.

Pick one:
1. [ ] Fix - Build this class in its own worktree and open its own pushed PR against the default branch; leave the primary's tracked files unchanged. [recommended]
2. [ ] Ticket - file one ticket listing them and change nothing now
3. [ ] Ignore - leave them as they are
